prompt: Use the provided crop as the approved visual reference and recreate it as a clean production asset at the target aspect ratio. This is a designed illustration plate. Output the same drawing, same style, same line weight and shading. Preserve silhouette, composition, perspective, palette (#f0f4f6, #082856, #2a6ac6), lighting, material, and texture exactly. Remove every piece of UI text, label, caption, button, and interface chrome that is not part of the artwork itself. Remove letterboxing, borders, card corners, drop shadows, and any layout background that the page will draw in code. Do not add objects. Do not change the concept. Do not restyle. The artwork fills the whole frame edge to edge at the same scale as the reference; no margins, no border, no background band. Region: fine-line Berkeley tower illustration and build people ideas tagline.
postprocess: The generated plate did not satisfy its own prompt: it returned a 1214x1296 opaque RGB image with a flat #032A5E background band and the words BUILD / PEOPLE / IDEAS / A BRIGHTER TOMORROW baked into the raster. The page already draws that tagline as live DOM text (.auth-rail-copy and .runbook-motto), so the plate rendered it twice, and the baked navy did not match the rail's #082856. Repaired deterministically from the delivered plate with ImageMagick: painted out the baked tagline region (rectangle 380,596 1214,1082), derived an alpha matte from luminance (-colorspace Gray -level 22%,94% -black-threshold 8%), recomposited the line work as flat #e9f1f9 ink over that matte, and trimmed to the artwork bounds. Result: 533x1045 RGBA, transparent background, no baked text, tints correctly over any rail navy. 1.2MB -> 84KB.
